title: Concept: Target-specific dependency declared as a wildcard
description: Cargo.toml declares a `*` version under a `[target.*.dependencies]` table, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` version under a `[target.*.dependencies]` table.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` version under a `[target.*.dependencies]` table.
